title: From Efficiency to Equity: Measuring Fairness in Preference Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on epistemic fairness in preference learning models, using datasets related to visual preferences of urban spaces and humor.
findings: There were no findings related to religion as it was not a focus of this study.
